title: Additive mode 9 Stock Curve public metadata

defaultGraduator.description: Registered handler's default. graduator may differ after a per-token governance retry and is bound by observed.binding.

graduationAligned.description: Optional sale GraduationAligned event with burnedRaw/keptRaw. V1 has no alignment event. Never assume a fixed burn percentage or infer total supply from this event alone.

graduatedTo.description: Sale GraduatedTo event with measured tokenAmountRaw after any alignment burn and quoteAmountRaw, before graduator dust handling. Must match the completed pool transaction.

totals.description: Exact raw-unit cumulative curve gross/net volume, refunds, allocations and locked-position collection sums; not USD revenue or guaranteed payout.

observed.description: Fixed-block state, actual total supply (not circulating supply), implementation minimum fee, current recipients' pending and graduated position. New fields are additive for archived V1 records. Block indicates freshness; historical platform recipients are excluded.
